title: Funky demo post
description: Starter body for a new blog post — intro, a subheading, a pull-quote, and a wrap-up. Loaded automatically when a new post is created with an empty canvas.

props.text: This is a demo post from the Funky theme. Delete these blocks and start writing — or keep them as a template for how a post reads with the skin on.
A subheading, in the loudest font available
Body copy sits at a comfortable measure with a generous line height. Links are hot pink and bold, inline code gets a yellow highlight, and block quotes come with a hard offset shadow.
Every post created with an empty canvas starts from this pattern — the theme decides the first draft.
Swap to the Default theme to see the same post calm down. The content never changed — only the stylesheet did.
